pathways.exit_policy: All lessons, KCs, required capstones, upgraded revisits, CARS, and SIRS/math remain in scope.

pathways.entry_condition: Future calibrated evidence may evaluate review reduction; current bypass is false and fail-closed.
pathways.exit_policy: Scope equals comprehensive; no current instruction bypass.

pathways.entry_condition: Begin Phase 1 independent of science; syntax support conditional and topic-neutral.
pathways.title: Parallel CARS Practice

pathways.entry_condition: Begin shared SIRS/math in Phase 1 and reuse only at accepted graph points.
pathways.exit_policy: All SIRS/math occurrences without Cartesian expansion.
pathways.title: Scientific Reasoning and Mathematics Integration

phases.entry_policy: Use existing evidence where available; otherwise precheck only route-changing below-ceiling skills and gateway claims. Prepared learners bypass repair, not required MCAT claims.
phases.exit_policy: Shared enabling and early model claims have evidence-ready representations; unresolved hard gaps route to narrow repair before unscaffolded downstream use.
phases.interleaving_rationale: Start shared math/SIRS, domain models, behavior, and parallel CARS.
phases.purpose: Entry calibration, conditional below-ceiling repair, shared quantitative/representation readiness, and immediate content–reasoning work.
phases.title: Calibrate and Establish Shared Models

phases.entry_policy: Phase 1 hard and representation requirements apply at point of use, not as a blanket phase gate.
phases.exit_policy: Core models can be retrieved in familiar and one varied authorized representation; capstones already used where coordination first becomes necessary.
phases.interleaving_rationale: Alternate domain model building and CARS while retaining hard order.
phases.purpose: Construct molecular, cellular, physical, cognitive, and passage models with early applications and continued scientific reasoning.
phases.title: Build Core Explanatory Models

phases.entry_policy: Only active hard prerequisites block unscaffolded use; helpful prerequisites influence support and order without excluding learners.
phases.exit_policy: Learners produce evidence for multi-cue selection, data-bounded inference, and representation conversion across authentic content intersections.
phases.interleaving_rationale: Coordinate mechanisms, experiments, representations, and CARS with reduced scaffolding.
phases.purpose: Reduce scaffolding while coordinating mechanisms, experiments, data, representations, and within-passage reasoning.
phases.title: Coordinate Content and Reasoning

phases.entry_policy: Required component and representation readiness precede each first unscaffolded integration; the PS p.89 hold remains off the required route.
phases.exit_policy: All required canonical KCs and relevant in-scope extensions have a first delivery point; CARS conditional transfer remains passage-bounded.
phases.interleaving_rationale: Use passage/representation transfer and capstone-only events without duplicate lessons.
phases.purpose: Mixed representation, passage, organismal, social-system, and integrative transfer with low scaffolding.
phases.title: Transfer Across Passages and Representations

phases.entry_policy: No new required content scope is introduced; every reference is a declared upgraded revisit of an earlier canonical claim.
phases.exit_policy: Readiness evidence samples all required scope, capstones, representations, and passage families; numeric thresholds remain build configuration pending validation.
phases.interleaving_rationale: Revisit every lesson once with named upgrade and no new required scope.
phases.purpose: Cumulative retrieval, mixed-representation integration, passage transfer, and readiness evidence without introducing a terminal reasoning block.
phases.title: Consolidate and Demonstrate Readiness
